subject: Executive handshake: proposed VP/CIO slot and coverage options
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@solstice-tech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-02T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Executive handshake: proposed VP/CIO slot and coverage options

Hi Liam —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our conversation, Solstice's CIO (Miguel) and VP Product (Dana) indicated they want a short executive handshake ahead of the technical demo. We want to make this painless on your side — below are two options and a suggested fallback. Can you confirm which works and whether Miguel will join live?

Option A (preferred):
- Wed 2026-09-09, 09:30–10:00 PT — 30m intro + 10m buffer
- Redwood execs: Stephanie (Customer GTM) + Marissa (Head of Sales)
- Solstice execs: Miguel Santos (CIO) + Dana Howard (VP Product)

Option B (backup):
- Thu 2026-09-10, 14:00–14:30 PT — slightly later window to catch end-of-day

If Miguel can’t make either, we propose adding a 10–15m pre-demo async briefing and asking Dana to be present for the live demo.

I’ll hold both slots tentatively pending confirmation. I’ve attached a brief agenda and a mutual action plan we can share with procurement.

Next steps: please reply with the option you prefer and circle who will be on the Solstice side.

Thanks —
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Solutions PM, Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com | (415) 555-0192

Attachments: Solstice_MutualActionPlan_v2.pdf, redwood-exec-brief-30m-agenda.docx
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@solstice-tech.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Miguel Santos <miguel.santos@solstice-tech.com>, contracts@solstice-tech.com
Date: 2026-09-02T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Executive handshake: proposed VP/CIO slot and coverage options

Hi Stephanie —

Appreciate the clear options. Quick update from my side: Dana is flexible and prefers Option A, but Miguel is traveling the week of the 9th and is only back late on the 10th. He asked whether we can either:

1) Move the exec handshake to Fri 2026-09-11, 08:30–09:00 PT so he can join live; or
2) Keep Option A and have Miguel join the first 10 minutes remotely, with a short async note from him if needed.

Contracts is also asking for a copy of the mutual action plan to start an internal procurement review — I’ve looped them above.

Can Marissa or Karthik confirm who from Redwood would be the escalation/contact for procurement items?

Thanks,
Liam
Head of Integrations, Solstice Technologies
liam.oconnor@solstice-tech.com | +1 617-555-0104
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@solstice-tech.com>
Date: 2026-09-03T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Executive handshake: proposed VP/CIO slot and coverage options

On Thu, Sep 2, 2026 at 11:02 AM Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@solstice-tech.com> wrote:
> Can Marissa or Karthik confirm who from Redwood would be the escalation/contact for procurement items?

Stephanie / Liam — happy to take point on procurement for this deal. I’ll be the procurement escalation and will run the MAP through legal with contracts as soon as we have the go-ahead.

On the scheduling side: Dana confirmed Option A if Miguel can do the first 10 minutes; otherwise he can make Fri 9/11 08:30–09:00 PT. Karthik, are you available on 9/11 morning as backup in case Miguel can’t make the 10-min join?

Marissa Cole
Head of Sales, Enterprise | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0146
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>

Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@solstice-tech.com>
Date: 2026-09-03T10:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Executive handshake: proposed VP/CIO slot and coverage options

Thanks Marissa — I can cover the 9/11 slot as backup. If Miguel can only do 10 minutes on 9/9, I’ll be standing by to join the live demo and take any deep-architecture questions he wants escalated.

Quick note on the agenda:
- 5m intros
- 10m business outcomes + immediate success criteria
- 10m technical alignment (KV caching/latency SLOs highlights)
- 5m next steps / procurement handoff

If that works I’ll be ready and will update the slide that highlights the latency / cost tradeoffs for their workload.

Karthik Iyer
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com

Hi Liam / Miguel / Dana —

Thanks for the quick coordination. Per Miguel's travel, we’ll move the handshake to the confirmed slot:

Fri, 2026-09-11 | 08:30–09:00 PT (30m) — exec handshake + procurement handoff
Location: Zoom (calendar invite sent)
Redwood attendees: Stephanie (Customer GTM), Marissa (Head of Sales), Karthik (Principal SE) — Karthik will be on standby for deep technical questions.
Solstice attendees: Miguel Santos (CIO), Dana Howard (VP Product), Liam O'Connor (Head of Integrations)

Attachments: attaching the MAP and brief agenda again for contracts and your legal review. Marissa will own procurement coordination and point legal/contracts to the HubSpot deal.

See you on 9/11.

—Stephanie
